name: lint-uz-suite
description: Suite of client-side format viewers under lint.one

scripts.dev: node build.mjs && cd site && npx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: node build.mjs && cd site && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.waitlist: cd site && npx wrangler d1 execute lintone-waitlist --remote --command="SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS people FROM interest GROUP BY format ORDER BY people DESC"

author: saidkamolxon
